verdict.rationale: Rev AI's feature docs state that the JSON transcription output includes timestamps for every transcribed word. The marketing site separately advertises precise word-level timestamps for media, accessibility, and indexing use cases. That directly covers mapping each word to its position in the recording. Missing for 10: documented detail on the timestamp schema and precision (start/end fields), explicit confirmation that streaming hypotheses carry word timings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
